description: Create a new Webmin user named 'dns_auditor' with the password 'AuditorAccess2024!'. This user must have access to the 'BIND DNS Server' module ONLY. Crucially, you must configure the permissions for this user within the BIND module to be strictly READ-ONLY. They should be able to view zones/records but NOT edit them, NOT change module configuration, and NOT stop/start the BIND server.
